about.summary: I build systems that have to work outside a demo: aircraft that land where expected and audit logs that hold up to scrutiny.

flight.heading: Flight
flight.body: I founded STRATOS İHA in Bursa and lead electronics and software for its 25-person engineering team. We reached the TEKNOFEST 2026 rotorcraft final (16th of 3,715 teams) and the NASA Space Apps Turkey final in our first year. I work with Pixhawk 6C, Raspberry Pi 5, ArduPilot, OpenCV, PCB design, and sensor fusion.

ai.heading: AI
ai.body: I build agent systems with LangGraph and Claude. Teluvane is a multi-tenant platform that hash-chains agent actions and audits them against EU AI Act, ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, and SOC 2 policies. Zero-G Pharma placed first in Türkiye at NASA Space Apps 2025 and in the global top 50 of more than 6,000 teams.

software.heading: Production software
software.body: I use React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, FastAPI, Postgres, and Redis, and ship with Docker, Kubernetes, and Vercel. Viyaro is a BOSİAD-funded autonomous mobility venture with 50,000+ rides across more than 10 companies. I’m a Tofaş Fen Lisesi student, class of 2028.
